use: Status in a table column, list or header: Active, In progress, Rejected.
figmaProps: No Brand: a brand color can look like success or error.
a11y: The text carries the meaning. The dot is aria-hidden.
content: One to three words, from the user's point of view: "Waiting for you" instead of "Action required".
do: Use one fixed list of statuses with fixed colors per product.
dont: A brand color for a status. It can look like success or error (Forest is green, for example). Use Info for "in progress".
name: Status indicator
summary: Status of an item with a colored dot and text. Calmer than a Badge, for tables and lists.
